conviction_note: I lean mildly positive. Q1 operating profit rose 15.9% and covers 48% of a first-half plan that assumes Q2 profit falls 21% year on year. The full-year plan assumes second-half operating profit falls 41%. Cawachi has revised its full-year forecast at the H1 print in each of the last three years, in the direction of the H1 gap. Against that, all of this has been computable since 29 July, the stock is up 38% since the plan was published and up 16% since Q1, and it sold its Q1 beat (-1.7% next day). So p_up is only 56 on a 3.8 scale, and the scaled +0.46 sits well under the +1.7 sum of the findings because the run-up already holds much of the beat.
bar: Company H1 plan (Mar 16 - Sep 15 2026): sales 145,800m, OP 3,000m, ordinary 3,500m, NP 2,300m; full year OP 5,100m, ordinary 6,000m. Source: Q1 決算短信 2026-07-29 https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260729/140120260727500251.pdf . No IFIS consensus and no analyst coverage (kabuyoho shows 0 analysts, https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportAnalyst?bcode=2664 ). 四季報 figure not reached. So the bar is the company plan only, and the market's implied bar is unknown but plainly above plan (PER ~30x on plan EPS). print_vs_bar is on H1 operating profit: my estimate is ~3,450m against 3,000m.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register 0.96% of shares outstanding (1 seller) as of 2026-10-27, down from 1.05%, so covering (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html via baseline). 信用倍率 0.44 (kabutan, 2026-10-28, https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=2664): the margin short balance is more than twice the margin long balance, which is a squeeze-prone setup. No option skew exists. Run-up +7.77% over 20 days and -0.5% over 5 days. The stock is up ~38% since the 2026-04-28 plan (2,906 to ~4,020) and sits at the top of its 3-year range. priced_lean +0.545.

findings.finding: Q1 (Mar 16 - Jun 15) operating profit was 1,447m (+15.9% YoY), with SG&A flat (14,837m vs 14,835m). Q1 ordinary profit is 48.9% of the H1 plan, against Q1 shares of H1 of 40.1% and 42.3% in the two prior years. The H1 OP plan of 3,000m implies Q2 OP of ~1,553m against 1,960m last year (-21%). Peers' same-store sales for Jul/Aug ran flat to slightly up, and Cawachi's Q2 comp is easy (sales -2.2% last year). That makes an H1 operating profit around 3,300-3,700m (+10-23% vs plan) the likely print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026-07-29 (OP +15.9%, released 15:30): -1.73% next day, -4.32% after two days. The beat was sold. H1 2023-10-26 beat (OP 4,392 vs 3,700 plan) came with an upward FY revision: +3.98% next day.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced. Anyone can compute the progress rate from the Q1 短信, and the stock ran from 3,475 at Q1 to ~4,020 since. What is not settled is the exact size of the H1 beat, because there are no 月次 (the company stopped monthly sales disclosure in 2018), no consensus and no analyst. If it were fully priced I would expect the stock to have stalled after Q1. Instead it kept climbing into the print, which suggests holders are still buying the beat rather than having finished.
findings.independence: Industry proxy, different source: ryutsuu.biz drugstore same-store sales, Jul (Tsuruha +1.7, MatsukiyoCocokara +2.2, Cosmos +1.2, Sugi +2.7, Sundrug +0.2) https://www.ryutsuu.biz/sales/s083171.html and Aug (+1.5, -0.2, +1.4, +4.3, +0.3) https://www.ryutsuu.biz/sales/s092578.html . This is a proxy, and goods sales (物販) were flat.

findings.finding: Cawachi revised its full-year forecast at the H1 print in each of the last three years, in the direction of the H1 gap: 2023-10-26 OP 6,000 to 7,000 (+16.7%), 2024-10-25 8,000 to 7,800, 2025-10-29 7,800 to 6,000 (-23%, plus a 20-yen commemorative dividend). The current full-year OP plan of 5,100m is 25% below last year's 6,779m actual and implies H2 OP of 2,100m against 3,570m last year (-41%). An H1 beat of 400-700m makes an upward FY revision at this print the most likely outcome, and no pre-release 業績予想の修正 has been filed since 07-29.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Upward FY revision 2023-10-26: +3.98% next day. Small cut 2024-10-25: -0.32%. Large cut with commemorative dividend 2025-10-29: +0.76% next day (悪材料出尽くし). Bars from https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/2664.T
findings.why_not_priced: No consensus exists to re-anchor, so the size of a revision cannot be in a street number. The price (PER ~30x on plan EPS of 134) implies earnings above plan but does not say whether management will commit to them now or keep the H2 cushion. The company has budgeted H2 heavily for systemisation, mechanisation and renovations, and its new medium-term plan is still pending. If a revision were fully priced, I would expect the stock to have stopped reacting to the absence of news. It made a new high on 10-26, so holders are still positioning for it. The risk is a held forecast after a H1 beat, which this run-up would read as a disappointment. That is why the range is wide and dips below zero.
findings.independence: Shares the Q1 document with finding 1 for the size of the H1 gap. The revision habit comes from separate documents: three years of TDnet revision notices and the kabuyoho revision table https://kabuyoho.jp/report?bcode=2664

findings.finding: The FY2026 短信 says the next medium-term plan is under review and will be disclosed promptly once finalised ('内容が確定次第、速やかに開示'). It had not appeared by the Q1 print. Cawachi also introduced a 50-yen interim dividend (annual 100 ordinary, +20) and completed a ¥2.0bn buyback (532,400 shares, 2.4%) on 2026-09-01, so shareholder returns are an active lever at PBR 0.78.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2024-04-26 dividend-policy change plus dividend increase at the FY print: +9.33% next session. 2025-10-29 commemorative dividend with a profit cut: +0.76%.
findings.why_not_priced: Nobody knows whether the plan or any further return lands with this release, so the price can only carry a probability-weighted option on it. The buyback and the interim dividend are known and priced. Only the timing and content of the medium-term plan are open, and its direction is uncertain (it could be heavy investment rather than returns).

findings.finding: Margin short balance is more than twice margin longs (信用倍率 0.44) and the one disclosed short (0.96%) is covering into the print. On positive news the short side has to buy.
findings.why_not_priced: Already in the baseline's priced lean (+0.545). It only amplifies the sign the release delivers, so it is sized small.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: likely (three straight years of revision at H1; the H2 plan implies -41% OP), most likely upward. Returns: interim dividend of 50 already guided, buyback done, medium-term plan pending and possible. New-year guide: not applicable (H1). Quarter: Q1 progress of 48.9% of H1 ordinary against 40-42% at the same quarter in prior years, so ahead of its own history.
baseline_tension: The findings agree with the priced lean (+0.55) and with the run-up, so they are partly priced. The strongest negative is a held full-year forecast, or a revision smaller than the run-up implies, which would be read as a disappointment by a name that sold its Q1 beat. Energy and wage costs in the summer quarter are an unquantified downside.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a call resting on a 進捗率 anyone can compute from the last 短信 is held by the price): finding 1, the Q1 progress beat, cut from +0.5 to +0.3 and p_up from 57 to 56. The rule is written for negatives; I applied its logic symmetrically to a visible positive.
Rule 1's exception (the release ADDS a forecast change): finding 2, the FY revision, left at +1.0, because that is the item the release adds.
Rule 2 (negative tilt): not triggered, since all findings are positive. I recorded the strongest negative (a held forecast) in baseline_tension.
Open question 4 (a run-in is not a short signal): the 20-day run-up was not sized as a negative.
